BL-782 — two teardown/liveness probes scan the whole process table, so BL-637's and BL-567's own suites fail on any host running a swarm — red that means nothing
What it solves: This is the same class as the standing operator lesson about `pgrep`/`pkill`
self-matching, one layer out: there the risk is a probe matching ITSELF, here
it is a probe matching a NEIGHBOUR. Both produce a survivor that was never a
survivor.
Approval context: Medium, not high: nothing is broken in production teardown — the probes work correctly on a quiet host, and the fix is scoping a match that is already scoped correctly on the adjacent line in both files.
It is not low either. Two suites currently fail for environmental reasons on the host that actu…
